# Candice Kuit (The Makeup Company)

> Hair and makeup artist based in Cape Town, South Africa. Bridal makeup artist in Cape Town under the name The Makeup Company, known for skin-first soft glam and bridal makeup for mature skin; also works across editorial, campaign, television and film. Represented for commercial work by One League Creative Management.
